study type: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial nested within a longitudinal cohort study
exposure: Time point (14 days, 28 days, 36 weeks gestational age)
outcome: Secretion of immune mediators (cytokines and chemokines) after T-cell activation
cohort: Extremely preterm infants (gestational age < 28 weeks, birth weight < 1000 g) and full-term infants (at 14 days of age)
finding: While immune mediator secretion was reduced in extremely preterm infants at 14 days of life compared to full-term infants, it mostly recovered by gestational week 36, suggesting immune maturation.
mod_finding: Delivery mode did not influence the cytokine and chemokine responses.
